scope_qualifiers.magnitude_cluster_determined: flops_reduction = cluster sparsity ~= 1-1/cluster (cluster 4->4x/8->8x/16->16x/32->32x); median ~16x is the grid's MEDIAN CLUSTER (16), NOT a flat universal magnitude; the robustness-across-N-and-noise is the real finding, the magnitude is cluster-set.
scope_qualifiers.recall_ceiling_regime: iso-recall validated in the CEILING-recall regime (both readouts recall@cos=1.0 across the swept grid noise<=0.30); recall-preservation under STRESS (softmax recall<1, the ~noise=0.40 band where nz explodes 8->193) UNTESTED -- measured-bounds; metric sensitivity PROVEN (recall 1.000->0.98->0.0 across noise 0.30/0.40/0.50, independently confirmed by cert-owner).
